task: Improve the root README for a developer deciding whether to try this local incident timeline viewer. Make the UI visible early, give an honest quick start, and keep its current limits clear.
facts: The app is a static, local, read-only incident timeline with bundled sample events.
It can be served from the repository root with python3 -m http.server 8000 and opened at http://localhost:8000.
assets/overview.svg reflects the current fixture UI and can be used as an early visual.
There is no file import, editing, account, collaboration, backend, or hosted demo yet.
